claims.claim_text: Examples of embraced high technologies include the Internet, laptops, mobile phones, high-speed rail, GPS systems and satellites, refrigeration, air conditioning and heat pumps, solar panels, wind turbines, and rechargeable batteries, on the condition their supply chains are made as socially and environmentally just as possible.

High technologies essential for modern material comforts must satisfy contextual appropriateness requirements, including use value relative to social necessity, energy demand and pollution for production relative to maintenance, and durability relative to recyclability.
